data.name: Vidhi
data.long_meaning: Vidhi is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the root word 'vidh' which means 'to know, to learn, to understand, to instruct'. The name Vidhi signifies law, rule, knowledge, wisdom, and justice. In Hindu mythology, Vidhi is the name of the goddess of law, order, and justice, who is often invoked before making any important decisions or taking any significant actions.
